name: X1
approved_by: owner (chat, 2026-10-13: "yes" to opening 2023+ once for this rule)
source: results/S2/trials.csv: best validation expectancy among 5,064 combinations with >= 100 training trades (rank 1 of 5,064). Chosen after seeing validation, so validation is not evidence for it.
costs: headline: OANDA bid/ask + 0.10 slippage on stops (net); half spread + 0.05 and mid prices reported alongside

criteria.inconclusive: fewer than 100 closed trades in the test period
criteria.pass: net expectancy > 0 AND 90% weekly-block bootstrap lower bound > 0 AND profit factor >= 1.2 AND positive in at least 3 of the 4 test years
criteria.weak: net expectancy > 0 but any pass condition missing
